notes.title: 2 players will be a character (NPC) in the game's next Chapter.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32540434/2e2c4d2d323b5707732145948fc42b703b804138.jpg[/img]

I've changed the number of winners to 2. One for male and one for female player. The first players who will get the "Pain is my ecstasy" steam achievement, will be one of the Non-player characters (NPC) in Chapter-2. He and she will be 3d modeled and textured as his or her real-life appearance. Then 3d animated and put in the game.

First player that emails the screenshot of the "Pain is my ecstasy" achievement's game scene to reward@thedarkinside.me will be the winners!
